add.title: Add a host
add.meta: Nothing on the host is exposed to the internet.

install.title: Install
install.subtitle: Run this once on the machine, or hand it to an agent already there.

connect.title: Connect
connect.subtitle: The runner registers itself with the hostname it reports.

add.description: Paste this prompt into the coding agent on the machine you want sessions on. It installs the runner and connects it. Nothing is exposed to the internet.

settings.updateDescription: The runner installs the newest release on its channel and restarts. Its sessions keep running, and open terminals reconnect in a few seconds. A host pinned to a version stays on it.
settings.updateFailed: Could not update the runner on {{name}}.
settings.removeRunning_one: {{count}} session is running on it. It is stopped and its terminal closed; logs are kept. The runner’s token is revoked.
settings.removeRunning_other: {{count}} sessions are running on it. They are stopped and their terminals closed; logs are kept. The runner’s token is revoked.
settings.removeIdle: No sessions are running on it. The runner’s token is revoked and automations targeting it are paused.
settings.renameFailed: Could not rename this host. Try again.
settings.removeFailed: Could not remove this host. Try again.
settings.wipe: Also delete everything on this machine: close every session and remove its worktree, uncommitted work included. Nothing is pushed.
settings.wipeOffline: {{name}} is offline, so it can’t be cleaned up from here.

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.title: {{name}}’s desktop
desktop.connectingDetail: The screen appears once the host has signed in to its screen-sharing server.
desktop.droppedDetail: The connection to the desktop dropped. Trying again.
desktop.offlineDetail: The desktop comes back when the host reconnects.
desktop.ended: This desktop is no longer yours to open
desktop.endedDetail: The host was removed, or you can no longer use it.

DESKTOP_001.title: This host doesn’t share its desktop
DESKTOP_001.detail: Whether its screen can be watched and driven from here is decided on the host. To share it, run this there, then try again:

DESKTOP_002.title: No screen-sharing server answers on the host
DESKTOP_002.detail: Turn on Screen Sharing (on a Mac: System Settings, General, Sharing), or start a VNC server listening on 127.0.0.1:5900, then try again.

DESKTOP_003.title: The screen-sharing server refused the host’s sign-in
DESKTOP_003.detail: Give the host the account and password the server expects: runner desktop on --username <account> --password-file <file>.

DESKTOP_004.title: The screen-sharing server asks for a sign-in the runner can’t do
DESKTOP_004.detail: Let the server take a VNC password, or no password on the loopback, then try again.

other.title: The desktop could not be opened
other.detail: The host could not reach its screen-sharing server.

desktop.pageLead: {{name}}’s own screen, live. You watch until you take control; then your clicks and keys reach it, the same screen its agents work on.
